title: Closed-loop phase-residual navigation under surprise disturbances

setup.controller: For l in {level-.05,level,level+.05}, predict 24 steps using current observed phase state and inferred extra shift. Minimize sum over 8-tick snapshots of 100(1-R) plus .1 times future correction cost plus .002 distance-to-former-nominal-target. Do not give controller true surprise directly.
setup.sensor: After each model update compare observed arm11 phase step to exact model prediction with zero extra shift; residual is inferred extra disturbance. Assumes full noiseless model state.

limitations: Exact deterministic model enables noiseless one-tick surprise inference; no sensor-noise or model-error robustness tested.
No physical actuator, actual energy measurement, real fusion, physical weak/strong interactions or quantum spinors.
Policy horizon and weights are prespecified; no universally optimal path proven.
All tests share a single synthetic model and gain policy lineage.
